_comment: ML-KEM-768 key-generation and encapsulation vectors, produced by Node 24's OpenSSL (v24.14.1) and committed as bytes because CI runs Node 22, which has no ML-KEM at all. Every seed is reproducible from its label; regenerate with the script recorded in tests/ml-kem-oracle-fixture.test.ts's header. seed is FIPS 203 §7.1's d||z: bytes 0..32 are d (drives ek and dkPke), bytes 32..64 are z (drives implicit rejection only). dkPke is the first 1152 bytes of the expanded dk, i.e. ByteEncode_12(s-hat).
